title: Weibull regression: time ratio and hazard ratio
summary: A parametric survival model reported as a time ratio (accelerated failure time), with the Weibull shape and the equivalent hazard ratio.

sizing._why: The catalog's log-rank form sizes a hazard ratio without a shape assumption; sizing a Weibull time ratio needs the shape and is a simulation.

pinned_defaults: Both: the coefficient is a log TIME ratio (positive = longer survival), not a log hazard ratio. The Weibull log hazard ratio is -coefficient x shape; here +0.33 and -0.49.
R: survreg's 'scale' is 1 / shape. Python: lifelines' rho_ is the shape on the log scale.
_extrapolation: A parametric model can extrapolate beyond follow-up; the extrapolation is only as good as the assumed hazard shape, which the data within follow-up may not test.
